frontmatter_snapshot.summary: CFA L1 Reading 7 (Simple Linear Regression) names the four classical assumptions — linearity, homoskedasticity, independence, normality — and pairs each with a residual-plot diagnostic. The deeper Breusch–Pagan / Durbin–Watson / VIF treatment the legacy card claims is NOT in CFA L1 2022; it is L2 / raw-econometric content.
